## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually run and any important limitations.

## Review

- [ ] No credentials, player data, logs, dumps, or private audit details are included.
- [ ] Financial precision, idempotency, and authorization boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests were added for security/financial behavior changes.
- [ ] Public documentation and modified comments/docstrings are in English.
- [ ] UI localization and user-authored content remain intact.
- [ ] Significant AI assistance is disclosed accurately where relevant.
